candidates.title: FLOW TRIAGE
candidates.description: Tap to open one of three tanks' valves at a time while the others keep filling on their own; deciding which tank to prioritize, and when to switch, determines which ones overflow.

candidates.title: SWEEP RUNNER
candidates.description: Drag a marker through the gaps between rotating radar-sweep arms to bank checkpoints, timing and routing your path as the sweeps speed up.

candidates.title: CHAIN IGNITE
candidates.description: Tap a node in a small connected graph to ignite it and let the ignition spread to its linked neighbors after a delay, choosing when and where to trigger the largest chain before nodes cool.

candidates.title: SLING ARC
candidates.description: Drag back from a target and release to launch a shot whose angle and power come straight from the drag vector, rewarding pulls calibrated to each target's specific power band over raw force.

candidates.title: PULSE DIAL
candidates.description: Drag to rotate a dial while a scoring window drifts around it at its own pace, requiring continuous correction to keep the needle inside the moving window long enough to lock it.

candidates.title: TILT FIELD
candidates.description: Drag anywhere to set the whole field's gravity tilt, steering several simultaneous falling orbs toward a goal pocket with one shared control while keeping hazard orbs away.

candidates.title: HULL WARD
candidates.description: Hold anywhere to raise a shield that grows the longer it's held and blocks incoming debris from any direction, while draining an energy meter that only recharges once you let go.

candidates.title: RESOURCE BID
candidates.description: Tap fading targets to claim their value out of a slowly-regenerating tap budget, forcing a choice between cheap targets now and saving taps for higher-value ones soon after.

candidates.title: ORBIT LANES
candidates.description: Tap when the reticle aligns with a target on one of several concentric rings spinning at different speeds, but only one ring scores at a time, so reading which ring is hot comes first.

candidates.title: MAGNET CHAIN
candidates.description: Hold to grow a magnet's pull radius, then release to snap together every same-polarity orb currently inside it for a combo, while mixed-polarity clusters cancel each other out.

reason: HULL WARD is the only finalist whose core loop — a growing omnidirectional shield that trades hold placement and duration against a drain/recharge energy budget — has no equivalent among the 20 published works (C1), and its success state is a direct geometric collision rather than emergent multi-object physics, making it the most reliably implementable of the three (C4) while still deepening in strategy as multi-directional debris waves and energy scarcity escalate together (C7).
